title: Bridging Distant Ideas: the Impact of AI on R&D and Recombinant Innovation
abstract: arXiv:2604.02189v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how artificial intelligence (AI) affects firms' incentives to pursue incremental versus radical knowledge recombinations. We develop a model of recombinant innovation embedded in a Schumpeterian quality-ladder framework, in which innovation arises from recombining ideas across varying distances in a knowledge space. R&D consists of multiple tasks, a fraction of which can be performed by AI. AI facilitates access to distant knowledge domains, but at the same time it also increases the aggregate rate of creative destruction, shortening the monopoly duration that rewards radical innovations. We obtain three main results. First, the effect of increasing the share of AI-automated R&D tasks is non-monotonic under specific conditions: firms initially target more radical innovations, but beyond a threshold they shift the focus toward incremental innovations. translated_title: 《连接遥远的思想：人工智能对研发与重组式创新的影响》
translated_abstract: 我们研究人工智能（AI）如何影响企业追求渐进式创新与激进式知识重组的激励。我们构建了一个嵌入熊彼特式质量阶梯框架中的重组式创新模型，其中创新源于在知识空间中以不同距离对思想进行重新组合。研发由多项任务构成，其中一部分任务可以由AI执行。AI促进了企业对遥远知识领域的获取，但与此同时，它也提高了总体创造性破坏的速率，缩短了奖励激进创新的垄断持续时间。我们得到了三个主要结果。第一，在特定条件下，提高AI自动化研发任务占比的影响是非单调的：企业最初会瞄准更激进（突破性）的创新，但超过某一阈值后，它们会将重点转向渐进式创新。第二，随着最优距离的下降，可能出现预期对数……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文构建了一个嵌入熊彼特质量阶梯框架的重组式创新模型，发现AI自动化研发任务占比对企业创新方向具有非单调影响——适度自动化会促使企业追求更激进、更远距离的知识重组，但超过阈值后企业反而转向渐进式创新。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a recombinant innovation model embedded in a Schumpeterian quality-ladder framework, revealing a non-monotonic effect of AI-automated R&D tasks: moderate automation drives firms toward more radical, distant-knowledge recombinations, but beyond a threshold firms shift their focus toward incremental innovation.
